Welcome to Indie App Spotlight. This is a weekly 9to5Mac series where we showcase the latest apps in the indie app world. If you’re a developer and would like your app featured, get in contact.

PulseKit is an all-in-one app for iPhone that makes it easy to track all of the key analytics that matter to you – without needing to code anything on your own. Everything is visible right from your home screen and lock screen with widgets.

Highlights

Out of the box, PulseKit allows you to link around 30 different platforms to view on your dashboard, with some of the most notable ones being App Store Connect, Cloudflare, Discord, GitHub, Google Analytics, Gumroad, Patreon, Product Hunt, Supabase, and Vercel.

This is incredibly useful for monitoring your app downloads, site traffic, product sales, subscription numbers, or server uptime – right from your iPhone’s home or lock screen. It also supports iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch.

For developers, creators, and builders, this makes this an easy all in one place to see how everything is performing – if it’s supported, that is. That said, the team is open to suggestions if there’s something key you’d like to see.

It also comes in handy with StandBy mode on iPhone, allowing you to monitor key metrics while your phone is charging at your desk.

Download the app

PulseKit is available for free on the App Store in a limited capacity for Apple devices running iOS 18.6 and later. For the full, unlocked experience with unlimited widgets – you can pay $5.99/mo or $59.99/year for Pulse Pro.
